caption:
India just shipped its first chip export to a US power semiconductor company. Not a design. Not a prototype - a packaged, commercial product.

Kaynes Semicon's Rs 3,300 crore OSAT facility at Sanand, Gujarat, was inaugurated by PM Modi on March 31, 2026, with capacity for roughly 6.3 million chips a day. The plant's first commercial shipment went to Alpha and Omega Semiconductor, a California-based power semiconductor company - Intelligent Power Modules for EV and industrial power systems.

One chip plant at Sanand would have been a milestone. A second one, shipping exports within weeks, is a pattern.

Sources: ANI News, Alpha and Omega Semiconductor (2026)
